The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8812` (see `QuestDbBuilder.QuestDbPgPort`)
- Port: `9000` (see `QuestDbBuilder.QuestDbHttpPort`)
- Port: `9009` (see `QuestDbBuilder.QuestDbInfluxLinePort`)
- Environment variable: `QDB_PG_USER=quest` (see `QuestDbBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `QDB_PG_PASSWORD=quest` (see `QuestDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /` to port `9000` is completed successfully.
